title: Coherent structural pullback commutes with additive power maps
statement: Let j:Y -> X be any morphism of schemes. Let additive endomorphisms FrZ and FrZK of their underlying Zariski structure sheaves be sectionwise pth power. The coherent additive endomorphisms defined by conjugating these maps through the fixed module/abelian comparison [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison] commute with moduleCohomologyFMap j for the structural module coefficient map [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. This is an equality on the actual right-derived module cohomology groups. No fields, properness, flatness, etale comparison or tensor-product isomorphism are required.

source.place: Tags 01FB and 01FD; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 03FD; derived.tex Tag 06XR: coefficient naturality, resolution normalization, and Ext composition

proof.text: Use coefficient transport with the fixed module/Ext equivalences. Their coefficient naturality and identity-edge formula identify module fmap with Ext inverse image, the constant-integer-sheaf comparison, and the adjoint coefficient map.

On every open the structural ring homomorphism commutes with pth powers. The adjunction square for the structural coefficient morphism therefore identifies invImage.map FrZ followed by coeff with coeff followed by FrZK. Apply exact-functor Ext coefficient naturality to obtain the power square in small Ext.

Changing the Ext universe commutes with coefficient postcomposition: map both sides to Hom in a common derived category and use composition. Hence coherentAdditiveEndomorphism is conjugation of the same small-Ext map. Conjugate the square by the fixed module/Ext equivalences and cancel the target equivalence, proving the stated equality.

theorem coherentFrobenius_pullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ X) (p q : ℕ)
      (FrZ : (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} X.ringCatSheaf).obj (unit X) ⟶
        (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} X.ringCatSheaf).obj (unit X))
      (FrZK : (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf).obj (unit Y) ⟶
        (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf).obj (unit Y))
      (hFrZ : ∀ (U : X.Opensᵒᵖ) (s : Γ(X, U.unop)), FrZ.hom.app U s = s ^ p)
      (hFrZK : ∀ (U : Y.Opensᵒᵖ) (s : Γ(Y, U.unop)), FrZK.hom.app U s = s ^ p)
      (v : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj (unit X)) :
      coherentAdditiveEndomorphism Y (unit Y) q FrZK
        (moduleCohomologyFMap j
          (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit j.toRingCatSheafHom) q v) =
        moduleCohomologyFMap j
          (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit j.toRingCatSheafHom) q
            (coherentAdditiveEndomorphism X (unit X) q FrZ v)
